resources.string: Aegis reads on-screen text in messaging apps on this device to check for grooming and adult content and alert the guardian. Message content is analysed on-device and is never sent off the device except as redacted alerts to the guardian.
Keeps Aegis child-safety protection active on this device and notifies the guardian if it is turned off or removed. Enabled with guardian consent; visible in Settings and removable by the guardian.
